name: image 0.25: JPEG decoding switched to zune-jpeg
baseline: image 0.24 and earlier, which decoded JPEG with jpeg-decoder
verdict_reason: image 0.25.0 replaced jpeg-decoder with zune-jpeg, which its author measured 1.5x to 2x faster. Upgrading image from 0.24 to 0.25 or later is the cheapest way to get the faster decoder.
tier_reason: The switch is documented in image's release notes; the size of the gain rests on zune-jpeg's author's figure without workload detail.
claimed_speedup: zune-jpeg is 1.5x to 2x faster than jpeg-decoder (author figure), adopted as the default JPEG decoder in image Version 0.25.0
workload: JPEG decoding through image::open / ImageReader with the default jpeg feature.
install: cargo add image (0.25.0 or later, released 2024-03-10)
one_liner: Since 0.25.0 the image crate decodes JPEG with zune-jpeg instead of jpeg-decoder; upgrading gets the 1.5-2x faster decoder for free.
how_it_is_fast: image delegates JPEG decoding to its codec crate; 0.25.0 swapped jpeg-decoder for zune-jpeg, which has SIMD color conversion and a faster Huffman decoder. Later releases track zune-jpeg 0.5.
use_it_when: You are still on image 0.24 or earlier and decode JPEGs.
skip_it_when: You need lossless JPEG decoding, which zune-jpeg does not support and jpeg-decoder does.
caveats: No benchmark in image's own repository quantifies the switch; the figure is zune-jpeg's author's.
image 0.25 also changed decoder traits (BufRead + Seek bounds, removed incremental decoding), so the upgrade is a breaking change.
The tiff crate still pulled in jpeg-decoder for a while after the switch (image issue #2289).
tradeoffs: Breaking API changes from 0.24 to 0.25; MSRV raised (1.88.0 for 0.25.10).

evidence.quote: Switched to zune-jpeg for JPEG decoding.
zune-jpeg is 1.5x to 2x faster than jpeg-decoder and is on par with libjpeg-turbo
